news.title: Purdue, Deloitte to discuss how technology is reshaping careers
news.summary_en: The "Deloitte x Purdue: New Careers at the Edge of Engineering and National Leadership" event will take place from 5-6 p.m. Monday, Sept. 14, at Stewart Center's Loeb Playhouse.

news.title: Purdue Engineering names four winners of faculty Thinky Competition focused on AI
news.summary_en: This summer, Purdue Engineering faculty created innovative web apps, AI skills, and agents in support of teaching and learning, combining their strong technical domain knowledge with critical human judgment.
